| description = Tserrina was once a renowned practitioner of the dark arts in Neriak. After becoming an acolyte to the vampire Mayong Mistmoore, they established a base of operations on Velious prior to the arrival of the gnome pirates and the opening of the continent to the old world. In preparation to wed Mayong she accepted his vampiric curse. However, it had unexpected consequences. Wings sprouted from her back and her appearance grew hideous. Not only did Mayong Mistmoore abandon her, but he imprisoned her in the Tower of the Frozen Shadow. In her insane rage she has cursed the inhabitants of the tower. 

<source needed. detecting strong fanfiction vibes>

Trigger mob is any '''[[a shrouded bat]]''' on the top (7th) floor of the tower. If it's a see invis bat, it will spawn Tserrina; otherwise, it will spawn an enraged vampire. Tserrina spawns directly on the bat's corpse. She paths toward the room at the end of the corridor and then up the spiral staircase and across the bridge before going back down again. ''There can be more than 1 Bat trigger up at a time for Tserrina, but there cannot be 2 Tserrinas up at a time.''

She will summon a skeleton pet. Gates and Summons.

NOTE: She is highly resistant—possibly immune—to being charmed: After she had charmed a max-level spectre pet off a necro, a cast of Tashanian succeeded but four (4) attempts to land Boltran`s Agacerie to deprive her of that pet all failed to charm her ("Your target resisted…")
